## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Verification

- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] I ran the relevant smoke test or documented why it was not applicable.

## Compatibility and safety

- [ ] I reviewed MCP, HTTP, storage, migration, and Memory Package compatibility.
- [ ] Tests, examples, logs, and screenshots use fictional or authorized data.
- [ ] The change contains no credentials, private exports, internal URLs, local databases, generated build output, or unclear third-party assets.
- [ ] User-facing limitations and migration steps are documented.
